title: Access, blood and pain
summary: A rifleman was hit in both arms by a burst. A buddy put a tourniquet on his left arm. He is awake, pale and in severe pain, and has lost a lot of blood. Your kit has blood of several types: find out which he can take.
objectives: Dress the right arm and the wounds under the tourniquet
Gain access on an uninjured limb: the left arm has a tourniquet (no flow, IV chance falls) and the right arm is damaged; an IO is the fallback that always succeeds
Check the dog tag before giving typed blood: only compatible bags count as blood
Give pain relief at the right dose (opioids are weight-based; a second dose too soon overdoses)
Blood volume back above 5.1 L at the end
